_noteW: Eye of Destruction: TotalDamage = BaseDamage(15-225) + 0.65 AP -- the guaranteed edge-of-blast number. SweetSpotTotalDamage = TotalDamage x 1.667 (the center-of-blast sweet spot) exists but is conditional on precise positioning, so the guaranteed TotalDamage is curated rather than assuming the sweet spot every cast.
_noteE: Mage Spear: TooltipTotalDamage = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage, 40-220) + StatByCoefficient(0.45 AP). Magic, knockback/stun.
_noteR: Rite of the Arcane: TooltipTotalDamage = BaseDamage(120-420) + 0.45 AP per landed shot, curated as ONE hit (count 1). A second calc, RampDamageCalc (RampBaseDamage 15-45 + 0.05 AP), adds an escalating bonus per CONSECUTIVE shot landed on the same target, and NumberOfShots (3-9) is rank-dependent -- neither is modeled here since the curated schema's castCount is a single static int and can't express a rank-varying shot count without overstating low ranks or understating high ranks; a conservative single-shot floor is used instead. Tagged BurstCeiling: focus-firing several ramping shots on one target during the ult's duration is Xerath's single highest realistic burst.
